translations.web: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army, and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them, and will prevail.
translations.bsb: But one from her family line will rise up in his place, come against the army of the king of the North, and enter his fortress, fighting and prevailing.
translations.kjv: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
